title: Telemetry
description: Bronze-layer event log. One row per sample per driver per lap. Sampled at ~10 Hz; ~2–5 million rows per race. Very wide partition   always filter by season and race_id.
x-notes: speed_kph, throttle_pct are float32 to save space. Sparse: many null samples for cars that DNF or have sensor dropouts. Race only; telemetry is never written for qualifying sessions.

x-phantom-columns.name: brake_pct
x-phantom-columns.reason: FastF1 exposes no brake-pressure channel; only the boolean `brake`.

x-phantom-columns.name: drs (boolean)
x-phantom-columns.reason: The real column is `DRS`, a numeric enum where only 10, 12, and 14 mean the flap is open.

x-phantom-columns.name: session
x-phantom-columns.reason: Telemetry has no session column at all; it's written only for race sessions, never qualifying.

speed_kph.description: Car speed in kilometres per hour. Sampled at ~10 Hz.

brake.description: True if brake pedal is applied.

distance_m.description: Distance from lap start in metres. Resets to 0 on each new lap. May have small gaps during pit stops.

DRS.description: DRS status enum. Only 10, 12, and 14 mean the flap is open; other values mean inactive. Decode once in staging; don't carry the magic numbers downstream.

driver_id.description: Three-letter driver code (HAM, VER, etc.). Links to laps.DriverNumber via stg_f1_laps.

season.description: Hive partition key. Always include in WHERE clause to avoid full scans.
